symptom: The nightly goes red on the Mendix 11.14.0, 11.15.0 and 11.16.0 legs, in `TestRunLifecycle_DetachStatusExecWaitStop`: `wait (Mendix 11.14+): build #2 applied without mxcli restarting mxbuild --serve; if this mxbuild builds incrementally again, drop the 11.14+ branch`, with the run log showing `build #2 applied via reload in 3.7-8.5s`. Every older leg, push CI and the unit tests are green
cause: Not a product defect: the improvement the test was written to notice. ako/mxcli#2150 (9156cf465, client_source_keep.go) copies aside the client source a serve build deletes and puts it back before the next, so --watch builds incrementally on the versions that bundle the client themselves. The test's 11.14+ branch still required serveRecovery's serve restart in the run log. The lifecycle test needs a cached mxbuild and a runtime, so it runs only in the nightly, never in the PR that changed the behaviour — the same path as 2026-10-23-nightly-11-14-11-15-runlifecycle-wants-serve-rebuild-hint
insight: The branch was built to fail when the restart stopped being needed, and it did, a day after the change, which is the cost of a behaviour pinned only in a nightly-only test: whoever changes client_source_keep.go, serve_recovery.go or the watch loop should run the lifecycle test on 11.14 and 11.15 before merging. Rather than drop the 11.14+ branch, the test now pins the new contract on every version: a page change applies via reload and the run log never says `restarting mxbuild --serve`, the phrase every fallback that replaces the serve process prints — so a keep that stops holding the source fails it instead of degrading to a 20 s cold build per change unnoticed. The boot-race step keeps claiming only that build #2 applies. Reproduce in about 2 minutes: `mxcli setup mxbuild --version 11.14.0`, JAVA_HOME at a JDK 25, `MXCLI_RUNLIFE_VERSION=11.14.0 go test -tags integration -run TestRunLifecycle_DetachStatusExecWaitStop ./cmd/mxcli/` (the old test via `go test -overlay`). Controls: the old test against main fails at line 159 with the nightly's message; the new test passes on 11.14.0 and 11.15.0; with newClientSourceKeep stubbed to nil it fails on 11.14.0 naming the restart, the log showing `applied via restart in 22.9s`
